# Billing Specification  

## Purpose

Charges and refunds.	

## Requirement: Charge

The system MUST charge a card.

### Scenario: Valid card

- GIVEN a valid card
- THEN it is charged

## Requirement: Refund

The system MUST refund a charge.

### Scenario: Full refund

- THEN the charge is refunded

## Requirement: Invoice

The system MUST email an invoice.
